items.title: University students in The Gambia protest over poor campus conditions
items.summary: Hundreds of students in Gambia's capital Banjul demonstrated on Monday against  poor conditions at the nation's leading university. Echoing demands by students across Europe, the University of The Gambia's student union called for a mass mobilisation, but urged participants to remain peaceful.

items.title: Ramaphosa deploys 510 soldiers to KZN amid anti-immigration unrest
items.summary: President Cyril Ramaphosa has authorised the deployment of 510 SANDF troops to KwaZulu-Natal under Operation Prosper to assist police amid anti-immigration protests following a landmark Constitutional Court ruling on asylum seekers.

items.title: Ukraine: firefighters battle flames and rescue dog from Kyiv ruins
items.summary: A Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv killed one person and injured 15. Emergency workers rescued a dog from the rubble, while strikes damaged university buildings and a major bridge.

items.title: Økokrim-aksjon mot fiskemottak: Flere personer pågrepet
